name: Food Concept Idaho
old_description: We design to your requirements at Food Concept Concession Trailers. We have been in the business for over 15 years. Tell us what you want to accomplish and we will make it happen.
about:
Food Concept Idaho operates from Nampa, Idaho, where Ozzie and Brenda Rodriguez founded the family-owned business to design and build custom concession trailers. Ozzie brings nearly 23 years of trailer design and fabrication experience, while Brenda contributes a background in customer service. The company emerged as food trucks gained popularity in the Treasure Valley.

The shop builds trailers from the ground up — chassis fabrication, welding, plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, and commercial appliance installation — all balanced for safe hauling. Every project starts with a detailed consultation to map workflow, equipment needs, and health-code compliance. The company reports more than 200 completed projects and over 150 custom designs, with a 100% inspection pass rate on new units. Warranties cover the structure for two years and appliances for one year through the manufacturer.

Customers range from independent coffee operators and taco vendors to specialty concepts like a mobile sushi bar converted from a bus. The company also serves clients needing cargo or toy-hauler trailers. Testimonials cite Bright Eyes Coffee, Tacos El Guey, and Basil and Bloom as repeat buyers.

The Rodriguezes attribute their speed and quality to their team, and they highlight a consultative approach that balances efficiency, comfort, and cost. Their differentiation rests on a 100% health-inspection pass rate, U.S.-built construction, and a willingness to tackle complex renovations such as the bus-based sushi bar.
